_meta.source: outputs/call-flow-playbook.md section 2 and call-flow-analysis.md. 12,354 transcribed bot calls (PS07 call turns, 1 Apr-30 Sep 2026); 70 calls read by hand for the 'worked' and 'failed' columns.
_meta.prevalence_def: share of calls where the seller said it at least once (text pattern, approximate)
_meta.meeting_rate_def: share of those calls that ended with a fixed meeting. Correlational, not causal.
caveats: Outcome labels are noisy: 4 of the first 20 calls contradicted the transcript.
'worked' entries come from calls read by hand (small samples, 1-6 calls each); they are leads for A/B tests, not proven.
nsd_csd_split is NOT computed yet: the transcripts are not joined to division. Fill from the builder's division fact if wanted.
_meta.enum_mapping_note: persona session's main_objection enum: none, why_meeting_not_phone, exec_came_before_no_change, no_enquiries, profile_already_complete, lead_quality, price_or_plan, busy, bot_or_trust, other. Ids below are stable; 'maps_to' is the proposed value, 'propose_new_enum' lists values we suggest adding because 6 of 12 land in 'other'.

objections.name: Busy / travelling / out
worked: offer a phone or online meeting to a travelling seller (3 calls fixed it)
ask for a rough day instead of 'tomorrow'

objections.name: No interest / no need
seller_says: I don't want to be online
worked: one question about what business they do
failed: a third and fourth restatement of the same enquiry count

objections.name: Confusion: what is this?
seller_says: how did you get my number?
worked: one plain sentence about what the meeting is, then the ask
failed: a canned 'are you talking about the meeting time?'

objections.name: Price / paid / trial
seller_says: can I get one month free?
worked: a straight answer, then 'the meeting itself is free'
failed: quoting two different prices in different calls
objections.note: highest meeting rate: a price question signals engagement; answer it directly (needs one approved price statement from the business).

objections.name: Phone or online preferred
failed: pushing for in-person anyway (one call logged a time after the seller said no)

objections.name: Owner / decision-maker elsewhere
worked: ask for the name and forward the message

objections.name: Is this a bot / recording?
worked: an honest answer (the persona session's identity rule now governs the exact wording)
failed: denying it ('main bilkul real insaan hoon' appeared in 24 calls)

objections.name: Repeated calls
failed: seller escalates: 'I will file a complaint'

objections.name: Distrust / bad past experience
worked: acknowledge the specific complaint and promise a different agenda (one call: 'this time the executive will focus on enquiries only'; it booked Friday)
failed: repeating the benefit after an angry reply (about two calls ended with 'don't call me again')
objections.note: 'bogus enquiries' overlaps lead_quality; if the persona enum keeps lead_quality, route that phrase there.

objections.name: 'I got no enquiries'
seller_says: not one enquiry has come (while the bot says 175+)
failed: repeating the count; the seller read it as lying
objections.note: only quote counts that are in verified_facts.

also_seen_not_scored: language not supported (Odia reply; the bot kept asking 'are you there?')
language switch handled (Tamil and English; the bot switched mid-sentence and apologised)
off-topic demands (17 turns of arithmetic; call ended not interested)
seller was actually a buyer (pivoted to sourcing, still booked a visit)
rules_from_calls: At most 2 asks per objection, then change approach or close; never repeat a sentence.
Answer price questions directly; the meeting itself is free.
Acknowledge the specific complaint before any benefit when the seller is angry or distrustful.
